[b]Preparations for War | Erene2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]
[Spoiler]
Fuelenger, late, walks into the extremely crowded underground bunker of the Palace of the Republic, with various generals, secretariats, and party leaders.

"Fuelenger. You're late."

Muller says, Fuelenger looks at him, he has a blank expression on his face, he can tell through the grating tone of his voice that he isn't exactly happy with him.

"Sorry. First Consul. I was...preparing my defense schemes for the Internal Revolutionary Guard."

Muller looks at him and rolls his eyes, and begins to speak, "Fuelenger. Can you address the gentlemen of the situation as of tonight to start this meeting?"

Fuelenger thinks for a moment, about to open his mouth. But given that he knew Muller was not in the mood for any further arguing, he would simply say 

"Yes, sir."

He would sit down and lay out a map, intelligence on fleet positions gained by the Stase through secretly installing cameras on international flights and imaging the sea. The positions of the Floueschian Army as of the current day, and the war situation in Nevonia.

"This is what the situation on the ground looks like right now. The Neue Republic, Oceanice, and Bantarus have all deployed forces to the white sea. Looking at this, I can definitely say that the other members of the EDU, and those deployed right now, also plan to deploy direct military forces to fight the anti-principalist. And, in something I deeply regret, we have not actually yet begun ground operations in Tallisland."

Fuelenger sighs, stands and begins to speak, looking at the reactions across the room.

"I have to be entirely honest. I have no Idea how the NVA is going to get on the ground in Tallisland at the moment. We need more time; most of the NVA's active units are fighting in Nevonia. And our navy is still non-operational. We can rush production on the carrier in Komend, but it won't be ready for another 3 months. And even if we did have the carrier and the two cruisers ordered, a direct confrontation with the EDU navies would be suicidal."

Fuelenger sits down, Julie Krier, President of the Revolutionary Council of State speaks

"So. Fuelenger. What do you suppose we do. We obviously can't just let them get away with this. This goes against everything we stand for, if they are willing to do this to Tallisland, esclate a small local conflict like this, what else would they be willing to do us. We must do something."

Muller stands up and looks at everyone assembled in the room

"She's right. We can't. As of right now im activating my War Authority powers given to me under the constiution, and authorized by the Staatsrot previously. This country is now in a state of unlimited national emergency."

Everyone in the room looks shocked, Klos Reuter, First Tribune, who was previously half a sleep awakes up and says quickly

"But Mr First Consu-" Muller stares him down

"No buts. This country is now under Martial Law. Inspector General, Secretariat of the Interior and Secretariat of Defense."

Inspector General Ivan Beissel, Secretariat of the Interior Claude Wagner and Fuelenger look at him, still dazed from what is occuring during this meeting

"Declare that the National Peoples Army is now under a state of mobilization. I want all reserves called up within the next 48 hours. The Internal Revolutionary Guard is to assume policing duties across the country. I want all currently mothballed and reserve equipment on trains to be taken to the refit factory within 72 hours. Announce curfews will go into effect shortly if the situation devolves. I want you all to also make sure that no panic buying occurs. Have the IRG guard stores if you must. We need to conserve all food just in case we come under a blockade. The same goes for fuel. I want all defensive measures undertaken, and activate the coastal defenses and air defenses. "

He looks towards the party leaders

"All of you need to get your sh*t together. Is that understood? I don't care what compromises, sacrifices, deals, you have to make, get me a unity government in the next 24 hours or so, help me, god, I will outright suspend the Staatsrot and activate the directorate clause of the constitution."

All of them looked shocked and looked amongst themselves, is he actually doing this?

"Secretariat of Rail and Transportation, make sure military vehicles and trains are given priority over civilian traffic on both the rails and roads."

Muller would go on giving directives to all Secretariats to begin preparing their various departments for wartime. Meanwhile, all tv programs in Floueschia would go offline and be replaced with recordings of dances and music

_______________________________________________________________________

[b]Emergency News Bulletin[/b]

After being off air for around 3 hours, Floueschian Television comes back online, the screen reads "EMERGENCY NEWS BULLETIN #1" with one of the government's press members standing at a desk with the Floueschian flag behind him. Additionally, this same message is played over all phones and radios in the republic on the order of the first consul. He begins to read

"This is an emergency news bulletin for the entire republic regarding recent developments. 3 Hours ago, the First Consul held an emergency meeting of the government in regards to the situation in Tallisland. Please contact everyone you know to ensure that they are watching or listening to this news bulletin.

As you may already be aware, the Republic is obligated, legally and morally, to intervene on the behalf of the Tallislandic republicans should unreasonable force be used against them, or should they face imminent threats or defeat.

Yesterday, as you again, may already know. The United States of Oceanice encroached upon this agreement in an illegal and extremely aggressive move. Invading the Anti-Principalist Coalition and launching a direct military invasion of the Tallislandic Republic.

The first consul, and the government perceives this to be a grave threat to not only the freedom of the Tallislandic People, but our own national sovereignty, the United States of Oceanice has proven that it is willing to harm the nations of Erene and the white sea. It has been proven that they are unreasonable and have no care for international law, which firmly rejects such escalations.

Given this, and after careful consideration, a state of unlimited national emergency is now declared in the Republic, and therefore, a state of martial law as well. The Internal Revolutionary Guard will assume all policing duties starting at noon today. The war authority clause of the Constitution has been activated, and powers over the government have been transferred to the First Consul, who will appoint a directorate of leaders to guide the nation during this time. This state of affairs has been brought about to ensure that the Floueschian People will remain safe and secure should the worst-case scenario come to pass.

The following announcements from the government to the general population have been given at this time:

1. Firstly, the rationing of fuel will now begin. Please keep car travel to a minimum.

2. Military vehicles are to be given priority on all roads; only emergency and essential services vehicles are exempt.

3. Please avoid panic buying; the government will ensure that food remains available. 

4. The Internal Revolutionary Guard will establish checkpoints across major roads and in cities. Please comply with their request.

Additionally, foreign nationals from the following countries are asked to leave the borders of the republic immediately or face arrest and deportation:

United States of Oceanice

Neue Republik

Bantarus

Lastly, A state of mobilization is now in effect. If you are a reservist for the National Peoples Army from any reserve division or an off-duty member of the National Peoples Army, please report to your assigned bases and post at your earliest convenience. 

_____________________________________________________

[b]Protest to the International Alliance[/b]

From: Foreign Secretariat of the Second Flouesch Republic, Christian Welter

Addressed: To the member nations of the esteemed international alliance

The Second Flouesch Republic, its people and government would like to lodge an official protest to the member nations of the International Alliance and its bodies on foreign affairs regarding the actions of the United States of Oceanice against the Anti-Principalist Coaltion in the Tallislandic Republic, and the general buildup of massive military forces by members of the EDU in the region of the white sea.

The Republic, and other nations in the region, particularly Thyven, deem the actions of the EDU unacceptable; they have escalated, intentionally, a local conflict into a large-scale crisis on the White Sea, which has forced the Republic and other nations to begin to prepare for a worst-case scenario. It has severely escalated the conflict within Tallisland into a full-blown war in their country, which inevitably led to the deaths of thousands, and the suffering of many more.

It is the opinion of the Republic that the International Alliance, as an alliance of peace between nations, has a responsibility and a duty both legally and morally to not only denounce the actions of the EDU, but also begin intervening in the conflict to re-establish peace and security in the white sea for all time. 

The republic is prepared to do whatever it needs to do to defend itself or its allies

Respectfully, Christian Welter

Fräiheet, Fridden, Brout a Rosen.
